messages:
mjordan: Heads-up — reproducible memory growth on longctx workloads (>65k tokens) when PagedAttention is enabled. Seen on H100 and MI250X, but behavior differs between them. H100 runs show large PT snapshot deltas and a burst of pagewalk retries that correlate with latency spikes. :thinking_face:

hao: Can you paste the minimal repro and any profiler output?

mjordan: Repro steps (short):
```
export MODEL=redwood-13b
export SEQ=65536
./bench/infer --model $MODEL --seq $SEQ --mode paged-attn --batch 1 --device h100
```
Log excerpt from the run that shows the PT snapshot mismatch and repeated evict attempts: 
[2026-03-18 13:02:11] kvcache: pt_snapshot: id=0x7f3e owner=3 path_len=12 mismatch(prev=0x7f31)
[2026-03-18 13:02:11] kvcache: pagewalk retry owner=3 index=18765 policy=evict
[2026-03-18 13:02:12] kvcache: evict: candidate=0x1b2c last_touch=+120s remapped=true
```

dmitri: Interesting — MI250X shows fewer snapshot mismatches but more fragmentation warnings, right?

mjordan: Exactly. MI250X: high fragmentation entries, lots of small holes -> reuse window decreases throughput but memory doesn't blow up. H100: fewer small holes but occasional stale PTEs lead to page rebinds and a leak-like growth until compaction triggers.

kate: Could this be a kernel-selection thing? I remember we have a separate pagewalk kernel on H100 that favors coalesced loads; if remap path isn't updating the shadow stamp, the kernel can see stale ownership.

hao: Good call. On H100 we pick kernel_kv_pagewalk_coalesce for sequences where avg_window>64. On MI250X we pick kernel_kv_pagewalk_sparse. If remap doesn't atomically update both page table and shadowmap, the coalesced kernel's prefetch can race with remap/evict.

cecilia: I saw a similar race earlier but it was masked by immediate compaction on certain workloads. Do we have an assert for shadowmap vs page table epoch?

mjordan: No assert right now. I added a lightweight check locally that logs when shadow_epoch != pt_epoch for the same slot. It fired ~4x during the H100 run above.

hao: Can you share that snippet?

mjordan: Snippet I used: 
```
if (shadow_epoch(slot) != pt_epoch(slot)) {
  log_warn("epoch-mismatch slot=%u sh=%u pt=%u", slot, shadow_epoch(slot), pt_epoch(slot));
}
```
Fired with owner ids that were remapped less than 1ms apart.

dmitri: Hypothesis: remap path does `set_pt_owner -> mark_dirty -> schedule_evict` but the coalesced pagewalk reads owner and issues a prefetch before `mark_dirty` is visible on the host. On MI250X the sparse kernel issues per-page checks which are slower but consistent with ordering.

kate: If that's right, we can either: 1) enforce a memory barrier in remap before publishing owner, 2) make the coalesced kernel validate shadow_epoch on load, or 3) change kernel selection heuristic to avoid coalesced kernel for high remap churn workloads.

mjordan: I ran a quick experiment: forcing kernel_kv_pagewalk_sparse on H100 (override in runtime config) removed epoch-mismatch logs and the memory growth stopped for the run. Throughput dropped ~8% but stable.

cecilia: Nice. That indicates ordering rather than fundamental allocator bug. Still sucks to trade 8% perf.

hao: For a fix we should prefer kernel change + add a cheap epoch check in the coalesced kernel; fallback to sparse kernel if mismatch detected more than N times per second. That keeps fast path intact for normal workloads.

mjordan: Agreed. I sketched a mitigation: coalesced kernel reads shadow_epoch for the first lane, if delta>threshold it aborts coalesced execution and falls back to per-page. Patch sketch in gists: https://redwood.internal/gists/kv-coalesce-epoch-guard (private link)

infra-bot: CI job #8429 finished: bench/infer (h100) — status: flaky — see https://ci.redwood.dev/8429

dmitri: Also let's add a longctx fuzz where we hammer remap/evict patterns to validate the heuristic. We need a test that mimics chat-app prefix growth + streaming.

kate: I'll own a patch: add epoch validation + metric (epoch_mismatch_count) + runtime flag `kv.coalesce_epoch_guard=true`. Will open PR and link INF ticket.

mjordan: Thanks — opening INF ticket INF-1429 now and attaching traces. I'll attach Nsight kernel timestamps and pagewalk traces.

cecilia: After patch, run repro on both H100 and MI250X, plus an A100 run. A100 sometimes behaves like MI250X in our prior experiments.

hao: Also add a microbenchmark that toggles `prefetch_threshold` and `remap_batch` so we can record perf curve and find a sweet spot where coalesced wins without causing races.

mjordan: Plan looks good. Quick TODOs:
- kate: PR with epoch guard + metric + config flag (ETA 2d)
- mjordan: attach Nsight traces and logs to INF-1429 (done)
- hao: add microbench harness for prefetch_threshold (ETA 3d)
- dmitri: run cross-arch smoke (H100, MI250X, A100) after PR merge

kate: I'll also add an assert in debug builds to crash on persistent mismatch > 1000/sec so we can catch regressions early in CI.

mjordan: Sweet. If anyone hits this in the wild, add "kv:pt-epoch-mismatch" to the support ticket so we can triage quickly.

hao: One more note — measure kernel_selection hotpath latency; changing to sparse occasionally increases per-token latency tail. We'll need to add fallback policy that prefers latency SLO for interactive customers.

mjordan: Agreed. OK moving to PR iteration. Will post link here when ready. :thumbsup:
